lines.t: I was running through the noise,
chasing meaning in the dust,
grasping things that slipped away
every time I placed my trust.
I called freedom something loud,
I called movement being alive...
but I never knew what rest was
till You called me out of time.
You didn’t wait for me to find You,
You spoke my name and drew me near.
In the middle of my wandering,
Your voice is all I hear.
I am Yours.
I am gathered.
I am home at last with You.
Not because I held on tightly,
but because You never let me loose.
I am Yours.
I am kept.
I can finally rest in truth...
I belong, not by my strength,
but by the promise You made true.
I was small among the many,
never strong, never enough,
but You called me to Your field
not for numbers, just for love.
You weren’t searching for my power,
You were asking for my yes...
You made gold from lowly soil,
You made beauty from my mess.
You remain the same forever,
I don’t shift Your hand or care.
My place is not up for debate...
I am safe because You’re there.
I am Yours.
I am gathered.
I am home at last with You.
Not because I held on tightly,
but because You never let me loose.
I am Yours.
I am kept.
I can finally rest in truth...
I belong, not by my strength,
but by the promise You made true.
From everlasting, You are 'I AM,'
to everlasting, still the same.
You knew me long before I knew
the sound of Your great name.
I don’t have to prove my place,
I don’t have to earn my stay...
I am held inside the One
who was and is and is to reign.
I am Yours.
I am gathered.
I am home and I am known.
Every fear of being scattered
dies inside the truth I’m owned.
I am Yours.
I am kept.
This is peace I never knew...
Not that I found my way to You,
but that You always brought me through.
I belong.
I am Yours.
I am home.
